verdict.rationale: Kling documents text-to-video generation (priced as a Text to Video tier) and supports iteration without restarting. Its agent workflow lets you refine and edit videos through multiple rounds, nodes preserve creative context, video-input generation is supported, Elements keep characters consistent across shots, and multiple versions can be generated at once. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on video-specific iteration (e.g., re-editing or extending an existing clip; mask re-editing is documented only for images), independent or hands-on corroboration of the iteration workflow.
